name: Honda CRF150R
intro: A small four-stroke motocrosser for teens. Valves and top ends need regular care.

H: Four-stroke motocross engines need frequent valve checks and oil changes. Follow the hour-based schedule in the manual, not the calendar.

recallNote: Off-road models are not always in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a Honda dealer to run the VIN as well.
